CustomField.description: Percentage of an org limit at which the Events feature is Paused (live push events to the chat window stop). Blank uses Org Limit Paused Percent. Between 2 and 100; whatever is set, AI Assist pauses at 95 percent of any limit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Blank uses Org Limit Paused Percent. At most 100; AI Assist always pauses at 95 percent of any limit.
CustomField.label: Events Paused Percent
